title: Copilot Studio retrieval benchmark — one result row per question per arm

arm.description: A SharePoint only, B consolidated MD, C AI-optimized MD

question.description: asked verbatim, copied from the question set

copilot_answer.description: reply verbatim; null only when the request failed

correct.description: matchAnswer().correct — full expected value present as a whole-token run

partial.description: matchAnswer().partial — some expected tokens present, not all. Never true when correct is true

retrieval_failure.description: the agent said it could not find the information, or answered about a different page

hallucination.description: a confident, specific answer that contradicts the source. Distinct from retrieval_failure, and more serious

grounded.description: the answer is attributable to a supplied source, not general knowledge

citation_present.description: hasCitation() — the reply names a file, page or URL

latency_ms.description: wall clock; null when not reliably measurable

notes.description: free text: anything the flags cannot carry

conversation_id.description: proof each question ran in its own conversation

request_failed.description: transport/timeout failure. Recorded and excluded from correctness rates, never scored as incorrect
